SSS31.name: 遗光鲹
SSS31.form: a fusiform body with a rounded belly, a pointed conical head, a small terminal mouth, cycloid scales, a slightly curved lateral line, a narrow compressed caudal peduncle
SSS31.fins: a long dorsal fin with a low anterior lobe, a deeply forked tail fin, long sickle-shaped pectoral fins
SSS31.markings: a row of small scutes along the caudal peduncle, a few luminous points on the upper flank

SSS32.name: 空时鳕
SSS32.form: an elongated slightly compressed body, a large head, a short blunt snout, a terminal mouth, a single chin barbel, small cycloid scales, a curved lateral line, a narrow caudal peduncle
SSS32.fins: three separate dorsal fins, two separate anal fins, a slightly rounded tail fin, pointed pectoral fins
SSS32.markings: a faint marbled pattern along the upper flank, sparse luminous pores on the head

SSS33.name: 逆时鳗
SSS33.form: a slender ribbon-like body of oval cross-section, a small pointed head, a short tapered snout, a small terminal mouth, minute embedded scales, a row of short ring marks along the flank
SSS33.fins: a low continuous dorsal fin fusing with the tail fin, no pectoral fins
SSS33.markings: a row of short concentric ring marks along the flank

SSS34.name: 千年纪鱼
SSS34.form: an oval laterally compressed body with a slightly arched back, a medium-sized head, a short blunt snout, a small terminal mouth, cycloid scales, a complete lateral line, a narrow caudal peduncle
SSS34.fins: a long dorsal fin with low spines, a slightly forked tail fin, fan-shaped pectoral fins
SSS34.markings: a series of thin stacked rings along the flank

SSS35.name: 虚空旗鱼
SSS35.form: an elongated fusiform body with a long slender bill, a pointed conical head, a small mouth, small embedded scales, a straight lateral line, a narrow keeled caudal peduncle
SSS35.fins: a tall sail-like dorsal fin, a deeply forked tail fin, long slender pectoral fins
SSS35.markings: a row of short vertical bars along the flank

SSS36.name: 纪元鲟
SSS36.form: an elongated cylindrical body with a flattened snout, a long pointed rostrum, a small inferior mouth, four barbels before the mouth, a row of bony scutes along the back, a short caudal peduncle
SSS36.fins: a dorsal fin set far back, a heterocercal tail fin, large pectoral fins
SSS36.markings: a row of angular scutes along the back and flank

SSS37.name: 黄昏鳐
SSS37.form: a flat diamond-shaped disc with a gently scalloped wing margin, a short blunt snout, a pair of small eyes set close together, a slender whip-like tail
SSS37.fins: large wing-like pectoral fins fused to the head, a low ridge running along the tail
SSS37.markings: a soft gradient of fine points spreading from the disc center

SSS38.name: 暗物质水母
SSS38.form: a smooth hemispherical bell of translucent glass-like membrane, a gently scalloped bell margin, tentacles arranged in two distinct even rows, a short central stalk
SSS38.markings: a single dense knot of luminous points at the bell center

SSS39.name: 回响鲷
SSS39.form: a deep oval laterally compressed body with a steep forehead, a large blunt head, a small mouth, the upper jaw slightly longer than the lower, ctenoid scales, a complete lateral line, a narrow caudal peduncle
SSS39.fins: a single long dorsal fin with low spines, a slightly forked tail fin, long pointed pectoral fins
SSS39.markings: a series of nested arcs echoing across the flank

SSS40.name: 时空褶皱·空棘鱼
SSS40.form: a stout oval body with a thick rounded head, a blunt snout, a large terminal mouth, cosmoid scales, a straight lateral line, a thick fleshy caudal peduncle
SSS40.fins: a single dorsal fin, a large rounded tail fin with a central lobe, thick fleshy lobe-like pectoral fins
SSS40.markings: a scattering of folded patches along the flank
